summary: American Tower Corp (AMT) filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its Strategic Collocation Agreement with DISH Wireless L.L.C., effective June 2, 2026. The termination notice was delivered by AMT, and DISH revenue has been fully reflected in churn since January 1, 2026, with no expected impact on 2026 financial results. AMT continues litigation against DISH regarding obligations under the agreement. This is not a special situation but a contractual termination and legal dispute.
